mapper.select: SELECT service_area_id,name FROM service_area WHERE status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY name
SELECT f.fault_type_id,f.name,d.name device_name FROM fault_type f JOIN device_type d ON d.device_type_id=f.device_type_id WHERE f.status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY d.name,f.name

SELECT ea.*,sa.name area_name,u.display_name reviewer_name FROM engineer_application ea JOIN service_area sa ON sa.service_area_id=ea.service_area_id LEFT JOIN system_user u ON u.user_id=ea.reviewer_id WHERE ea.user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY ea.created_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT application_id FROM engineer_application WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND status='PENDING'
SELECT service_area_id FROM service_area WHERE service_area_id=#{areaId} AND status='ACTIVE'
SELECT fault_type_id FROM fault_type WHERE fault_type_id=#{faultId} AND status='ACTIVE'
SELECT user_id FROM system_user WHERE role_type='ADMIN' AND status='ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification(receiver_id,notification_type,title,content,related_business_type,related_business_id) VALUES(#{adminId},'ENGINEER_APPLY','新的工程师认证待审核',#{content},'ENGINEER_APPLICATION',#{applicationId})
mapper.select: SELECT ea.*,su.display_name user_name,sa.name area_name,ru.display_name reviewer_name FROM engineer_application ea JOIN system_user su ON su.user_id=ea.user_id JOIN service_area sa ON sa.service_area_id=ea.service_area_id LEFT JOIN system_user ru ON ru.user_id=ea.reviewer_id ORDER BY CASE ea.status WHEN 'PENDING' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,ea.created_at DESC

SELECT eas.application_id,ft.name fault_name,dt.name device_name FROM engineer_application_skill eas JOIN fault_type ft ON ft.fault_type_id=eas.fault_type_id JOIN device_type dt ON dt.device_type_id=ft.device_type_id ORDER BY eas.application_id,dt.name,ft.name
SELECT * FROM engineer_application WHERE application_id=#{applicationId} AND status='PENDING'
SELECT engineer_id FROM engineer_profile WHERE engineer_id=#{userId}
SELECT fault_type_id FROM engineer_application_skill WHERE application_id=#{applicationId}
